text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One night, Calstone Light O was watching 
underwater footage called "Home Adventure! 
The Ocean World."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, diving even deeper?! What could 
possibly be at the bottom of the sea—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Is this coral?! To think such brilliantly 
colored coral exists.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"For someone who can't dive, it's truly an 
alien world. A mystical sight. I could 
watch it forever."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up getting sucked into watching 
deep-sea diving videos and stayed up way 
too late...
